subject.name: AP Human Geography
subject.cedVersion: AP Human Geography CED (Course Framework V.1, (c)2020 posted edition; 2027 exam: fully digital, 60 MC/60 min, 3 FRQ/75 min, scheduled May 3, 2027)
subject.designNotes: 7 units with weights, topic codes/titles and class periods from the posted CED (read 2026-10-20; the posted PDF is dated 2020, and the AP Central exam page lists no 2027 structural change). Exam: fully digital; Section I 60 MC, 60 min, 50% (30-40% of questions use stimulus material, individual and set-based); Section II 3 FRQ, 75 min, 50% (7 points each; Q1 no stimulus, Q2 one stimulus, Q3 two stimuli; each assesses at least two units). Calculator use is not mentioned. Skill categories 1-5 (Concepts and Processes, Spatial Relationships, Data Analysis, Visual Analysis, Scale Analysis) with MC and FRQ weightings from the CED. Per-topic and per-sub-keyword skills are an ALTON editorial mapping (one skill per sub-keyword chosen by kind and content), not the CED's per-topic suggested skills. Sub-keywords, kinds, requires and estLessons are ALTON editorial designs, not CED content. Topic titles are the CED's where read from the CED course-at-a-glance; where the extracted text was truncated they are close paraphrases.
